faqs.q: Where and how is the MannTek heavy-duty double ball race swivel joint used?
faqs.a: The MannTek heavy-duty swivel joint runs on two ball races so it can carry heavy side loads. It gives free rotation between a hose assembly and the fixed point of a plant or pipe system, in sizes from 1" to 10". This listing carries 8 part numbers, covering 1" (DN 25) to 10" (DN 250).

faqs.q: What sizes and part numbers are listed for the MannTek heavy-duty double ball race swivel joint?
faqs.a: The heavy-duty swivel is listed in 1" (DN 25), 2", 3", 4", 5", 6", 8" and 10" (DN 250), each as its own Indus part number such as IH-MNT-SWV-HD-025. Connections are threaded or flanged and are specified per order.

faqs.q: How should I select the MannTek heavy-duty double ball race swivel joint for my application?
faqs.a: Choose the double ball race when the swivel carries heavy side loads or when the bore is above 4" up to 10", then fix the body material, seals and connection on each side. For lighter duty up to 4" the single ball race is listed separately.

faqs.q: What pressure rating does the MannTek heavy-duty double ball race swivel joint have?
faqs.a: MannTek publishes a working pressure of 16 to 25 bar for the the MannTek heavy-duty double ball race swivel joint, depending on size and material. The figure for your build is confirmed with the quotation, so send the size, body material, seal and medium and we state the rating in writing.

faqs.q: What is the MannTek heavy-duty double ball race swivel joint made from?
faqs.a: The body is stainless steel 1.4404 (AISI 316L) or aluminium in every size, with FKM, NBR, EPDM, FFKM or PTFE seals. MannTek suggests stainless steel for chemicals and foodstuffs and aluminium for petroleum-based products, so tell us the medium and we confirm body and seals.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the MannTek heavy-duty double ball race swivel joint?
faqs.a: MannTek publishes an operating manual and a service instruction for its swivel joints, which are attached in the Documents tab of the listing for installation, operation and servicing. No other standard or certificate is stated on the listing, so ask in the enquiry if you need a material or conformity document.

faqs.q: Which parts does the MannTek heavy-duty double ball race swivel joint mate with?
faqs.a: Each side is threaded or flanged, specified per order, so it connects a hose assembly to the fixed point of a plant or pipe system. See [the single ball race swivel](/p/manntek-swivel-joint-single-ball-race) for lighter duty up to 4" with a wider choice of materials.

faqs.q: How should the MannTek heavy-duty double ball race swivel joint be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: Read MannTek's operating manual and service instruction in the Documents tab before the swivel arrives so the site team has the procedure to hand. Put the swivel at the point that has to turn, behind a nozzle or coupling or between hose and fixed pipework, and check the seals at each service.

faqs.q: Which industries and jobs use the MannTek heavy-duty double ball race swivel joint?
faqs.a: The MannTek heavy-duty double ball race swivel joint lets a nozzle, coupling, loading arm or other equipment on a hose line rotate freely, so the hose does not twist. That extends the life of the hose and the equipment on it and makes the line easier to handle, on tanker, plant and manifold connections.

faqs.q: How does the MannTek heavy-duty double ball race swivel joint differ from the MannTek single ball race swivel joint?
faqs.a: The double ball race swivel takes heavy side loads and runs from 1" to 10" in stainless steel or aluminium, while [the MannTek single ball race swivel joint](/p/manntek-swivel-joint-single-ball-race) is the standard-duty type for 1" to 4" with brass, gun metal, titanium and Hastelloy bodies as well. Both are rated 16 to 25 bar by size and material.

faqs.q: What is the MannTek single ball race swivel joint used for?
